title: Five vendor-neutrality defects AGENTS.md still tracked as prose are open at HEAD after the rest of that ledger was found fixed and retired: two B200 literals in the test-only launch_cubin_once chain, an arm-kind refusal worded in CUDA's words, the warps spelling, two NVIDIA mnemonics in the neutral IR, and warp-width literals in two emitters
backend: native_cuda, metal, cutlass_cute_dsl; the Evaluation CUDA driver and the Lab reference-access check
target: sm_100a and sm_103a for the driver literals; every declared target for the IR, emitter and arm-kind items
executor_revision: none: this record is read from the source tree, no campaign is involved

evidence.retained: the checkout at the commit named above, read on the reform/occam branch whose working tree differs from it only by staged deletions and docs/history/identities.json; none of the sites below is among the deleted files. The 2026-09-18 architecture audit's C11 verdicts (three lenses, none refuted) list which of the ledger's ~26 citations still land; each site below was re-read at that commit before it was recorded here
sites: src/open_cake_ir/evaluation/cuda_driver.py:479 -- `if resources["CU_FUNC_ATTRIBUTE_BINARY_VERSION"] != 100:` inside launch_cubin_once (defined at :444), where the same file's launch path checks `!= cuda_architecture(manifest.target)` at :234

src/open_cake_ir/evaluation/cuda_driver.py:486-488 -- the shared-memory sum is compared against MAX_DYNAMIC_SHARED_MEMORY_BYTES (232_448, evaluation/cuda_manifest.py:15) and refused as 'exceeds B200 limit', where :241 reads `cuda_target(manifest.target).resource_limits.maximum_shared_memory_bytes`

src/open_cake_ir/evaluation/cuda_driver.py:581 -- launch_candidate_once is the only in-tree caller of launch_cubin_once; both are exported from evaluation/__init__.py:54-55 and their only callers outside that module are the six call sites in tests/contracts/test_cuda_driver.py (:220, :248, :286, :312, :416, :435)

src/open_cake_ir/lab/reference_access.py:51 -- `if kind not in {"open_cake", "direct_cuda"}:` raises 'inherited target_implementation requires known_kernel_reproduction' for any arm kind the set does not enumerate, including an arm that never had an inherited implementation; :15 already names the three access categories neutrally

src/open_cake_ir/compiler/ir/resources.py:31 -- `warps: tuple[int, ...]` is the only accepted spelling for a role's execution slots; src/open_cake_ir/compiler/core.py:272 reports `total_warps` for every target; backends/metal.py:140 reads it and reports 'consecutive SIMD groups'

compiler/revision.json -- `calibration_coverage` is `[]` in all 97 commits that touched the file, and in all 87 retired locks now at history:compiler/releases/*/revision.lock.json, so no calibration binding depends on semantic_sha256 today

src/open_cake_ir/compiler/ir/operations.py:84-87 -- PLACED_CONTRACTS holds `tcgen05.mma.cta_group::1.kind::f16` and `mma.sync.aligned.m16n8k16.row.col.f32.bf16.bf16.f32`, two NVIDIA mnemonics in the vendor-neutral IR; the prefix match the comment at :79 describes is gone, the rows are not, and src/open_cake_ir/compiler/schema.py:102 projects the set to every author of every target

src/open_cake_ir/compiler/backends/metal.py:63 -- `SIMD_WIDTH = 32`, read at :74, :88, :98, :150 and :345, while the three Apple Target documents each declare `warp_size: 32` and the backend never reads it

src/open_cake_ir/compiler/backends/native_cuda.py:459, :548, :556, :803 -- `*32` transcribed into the thread count and lane arithmetic; backends/cutedsl.py:675, :677 and :1021 carry the same literal into emitted source; sm_100a.json and sm_103a.json declare `warp_size: 32` and neither backend reads it

observation:
AGENTS.md's 'Targets are peers' section was written on 2026-09-13 as a measured-defect ledger and its first fix landed within the minute. By c75ee4b3 the audit found that of its ~26 file:line citations fewer than ten still landed and at least eleven of the named defects were closed: warp_size is declared at target.py:443, vendor is a closed enum read positively, executable_role reads code_object, the barrier pair is quoted from BarrierMechanism and a test forbids the literal, the register-cap crash is a TARGET_REGISTER_CAP_UNMODELED report, corpus.py names examined and unexamined targets, and test_vendor_neutrality.py holds fifteen tests against a synthetic third vendor. The section was rewritten on 2026-09-18 as invariants with the code and test that hold each one. That rewrite deletes the prose that was the only place five still-open items were tracked, so this record is where they live now.

(1) The exported launch_cubin_once transcribes `BINARY_VERSION != 100` and a B200 shared-memory constant where the production launch path in the same file reads both from the manifest's declared Target. The permissive direction is the dangerous one: an sm_100a cubin passes `100 != 100` under an sm_103a manifest. Neither function has a caller in src or tools, so today this is a duplicated check with no production consequence; a duplicate is a defect while it still agrees because it is found when it stops. (2) reference_access.py:51 refuses an unenumerated arm kind for an inherited implementation it never had; the refusal is required, its CUDA wording is not. (3) `warps` is one vendor's word for a shared concept. The earlier reason to defer the rename -- that semantic_sha256 covers the whole Schedule document and a rename voids every calibration binding -- protects nothing: calibration_coverage has been empty in every commit and every retired lock. (4) PLACED_CONTRACTS decides placement by name rather than by prefix now, but the two names are NVIDIA's and live in the neutral IR, and the authoring Schema republishes them to every target's authors. (5) metal.py and native_cuda.py keep 32 as a literal although every Target they emit for declares warp_size; a backend may keep its own ISA constant, it may not be the second owner of a declared one, and the declared value is what test_declared_warp_size.py holds the shared computations to.
proposed_change: Each item has an owner and a phase in the 2026-09-18 reform plan; none is a Phase 0 change and none is bundled with another. (1) Retire the transcribed checks in launch_cubin_once in favour of the per-target reads at cuda_driver.py:234 and :241, or delete the test-only chain with its six test call sites; either way the file keeps one owner per fact. (2) Have the arm-kind check at reference_access.py:51 refuse an unenumerated kind for the reason that applies to it, in the Lab's words. (3) Rename Role.warps and total_warps to a neutral spelling as its own hash-only tick, authorized under owner decision D4 and scheduled for Phase 5: it changes every Schedule document's semantic_sha256 and therefore every Corpus expectation, so it lands alone, with the expectation refresh as a separate reviewed act that names this record as its reason. (4) Move the two placed-contract names into the per-contract registry Phase 1 introduces, so a contract says whether it places its operands and the IR holds no vendor mnemonic. (5) In Phase 1, have metal.py and native_cuda.py read the declared warp_size through the route requirements Phase 1 hands the offline jail, which today opens no Target document, and extend test_declared_warp_size.py's shared-constant check to the emitters. Verification is by the absence each change is for -- a grep that finds no `!= 100`, no `B200 limit`, no `{"open_cake", "direct_cuda"}` refusal wording, no `*32` in an emitter -- plus a Corpus Gate with expectations unchanged for (1), (2), (4) and (5) and refreshed once, reviewed, for (3).
